title: Quenched, Melted Syrian Lamb Biryani
description: A rich, flavorful biryani dish from Syria, featuring lamb, rice, and spices, all blended together in a molten, savory sauce.
instructions: Rinse the rice in a fine mesh strainer and soak it in water for 30 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Grind the cumin, coriander, turmeric, salt, and black pepper into a fine powder using a mortar and pestle.
Heat the ghee or oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the sliced onions and cook until they are lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the ground lamb and cook until it is browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Stir in the spice powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the soaked and drained rice to the saucepan and stir to coat the rice with the spice mixture.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan, and cook until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
While the rice is cooking, heat the same saucepan over medium heat and add the kasoori methi.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and cook for 1 minute.
To serve, place the cooked lamb and rice mixture in a large serving dish and spoon the molten sauce over the top.
Garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
